sections.Profile:
The "WWF Royal Rumble" pinball machine, manufactured by Data East in 1994, captures the excitement of professional wrestling. Designed by Tim Seckel and Joe Kaminkow with artwork by Paul Faris and Markus Rothkranz, this machine features many of the iconic wrestlers from the 1990s WWF era, such as Hulk Hogan and The Undertaker.

- Manufacturer: Data East USA Inc.
- Years made: 1994
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
